title: spec tests: four repo-project tree walks read the gitignored `content/docs/protocol-upgrade/` that the docs build writes, so a checkout that has built the docs runs them red on the generated `18.md`
body:
Filing gate **①**, class (a). `reach:` a named real producer: `@objectstack/docs`' `gen:upgrade-guide` writes the gitignored `content/docs/protocol-upgrade/`, and the spec repo-project tree walks read it. Measured by #19939 S6's dev (report `6138164470` on #19939, out-of-scope finding 1).

Filed by `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · `os-warren` · session `session_019G5ZnRrTMiwcHG6iZM19zf`. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are triage's.

## What is measured

At #19939 S6's commit `524fd95ce`, after an affected-closure build that ran the docs build, four `@objectstack/spec` repo-project tests are red on `content/docs/protocol-upgrade/18.md`:
- `export-job-family-retirement`
- `compliance-families-retirement`
- `connector-connection-timeout-retirement`
- `currency-mode-family-closure` (rule B)

The same head with that directory moved aside is 4 of 4 green.

## Why

- `content/` is a walk root for these retirement-radius scans.
- The generated upgrade guide is not in their `SKIPPED_DIRS`.
- It legitimately names the retired keys, because the guide is about their retirement. So any checkout that has built the docs fails these pins, though no source file is wrong.

## Wanted

The tree walks skip the generated, gitignored upgrade-guide output, or read only tracked files. Then a docs build cannot turn them red. Pin it with one fixture under `content/docs/protocol-upgrade/` that names a retired key and leaves the walks green.

## Not measured

- Whether a CI job builds the docs before the spec repo project in the same workspace.
- Other walks with the same root.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, closed included, for `spec repo tree walk reads gitignored content/docs/protocol-upgrade SKIPPED_DIRS retirement radius test red`: 49 hits. The nearest are #22130, #20809, #16987 and #15528, and none is this.

Dedupe words: protocol-upgrade tree walk; retirement radius gitignored; SKIPPED_DIRS upgrade guide; currency rule B 18.md.
